notes.title: Fourmiworld - Soundtrack & more: OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3922420/Fourmiworld_Original_Soundtrack/"]The Fourmiworld Soundtrack is now available for all![/url][/h3][p]It's been 3 entire weeks since we released Fourmiworld, and we've been REALLY happy to see how positively received the game has been! In-between patching the game and pondering future projects, we've been working on the release of the soundtrack for everyone to enjoy... well, the time has come![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3922420/Fourmiworld_Original_Soundtrack/"]The soundtrack has released & is currently on sale in celebration of that fact![/url][/p][p][/p][p]"But why would I want to get the soundtrack?", you say? "I can already listen to these tracks in-game!"... you're right! [b]But can you listen to them in remastered, lossless quality, on demand whenever you desire?[/b] I think not![/p][p][/p][h3]Actually, there are [b]several things that are exclusive to the soundtrack's release[/b], such as:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Extended trailer music![/b][/p][/*][*][p]A [b]never-before-heard[/b] bonus song![/p][/*][*][p]And [b]SIX all-new remix tracks![/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We wanted this release to not only be comprehensive, but to go above-and-beyond! Thank you so, so much from the bottom of our hearts - seeing all the positive reviews, the discussion around the game, the community we've discovered, and the regulars on the Discord really makes our hearts melt. It is all we could ever hope for as creatives. We really hope you enjoy listening to everything we've made.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]A message from CZDOOM[/h3][p]Fourmiworld has been both of our lives for the past 9 months. We're ready to look towards new horizons and see what the future has in store for us - just as much as Wandereye is probably scrolling for a new adventure as we speak.[/p][p]Regardless of whether or not what we work on in the future is related to Fourmiworld, we'd be eternally grateful to have you there with us to check it out. Alongside this release, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57495/Fourmiworld_Supporter_Bundle/"]we are also now offering a supporter bundle on Steam[/url][/b] - you'll now be able to purchase both the DLC & the soundtrack together at a lower total price than if you were to buy them both separately. Thanks, BoRIS. You're the goat.[/p][p]If you ever have anything at all to ask, say, or send us, you can email [url="https://contactczdoom@gmail.com"]contactczdoom@gmail.com[/url] or [url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca"]join our Discord server[/url] at any time. The Discord is full of cool, chill people! Join it, you cool, chill person, you![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][list][*][p]Cheyenne[/p][/*][*][p]Zoe[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]                                                      [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3922420/Fourmiworld_Original_Soundtrack/" style="button"]Fourmiworld Soundtrack Page[/url][/p][p]                                                           [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57495/Fourmiworld_Supporter_Bundle/" style="button"]Supporter Bundle Page[/url][/p][p]                                                                [url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca" style="button"]CZDOOM Discord[/url][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fourmiworld Version 1.0.6 Lice released
notes.content: [h3]We've updated Fourmiworld to Version 1.0.6 Lice.[/h3][p]This is a small patch which fixes some typos in the Fourmipedia as well as (hopefully) fixes some potential soft-locks, among other tweaks.[/p][p][/p][p]Read a more detailed list below, but beware of potential spoilers for things you may not have found.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Added some fail-safes that should fix potential soft-locks.,[/p][/*][*][p]Psychic Mantis should now repeat itself less.,[/p][/*][*][p]Chuggers now have to be scared away to unlock their Fourmipedia entry, rather than simply seeing them on screen.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various Fourmipedia entry typos we had previously missed.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fourmiworld Version 1.0.5 Jewel Beetle released
notes.content: [h3]We've updated Fourmiworld to Version 1.0.5 Jewel Beetle.[/h3][p]This is a small patch which adds two quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p][b]Thank you to our speedrunning community on the [url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca"]CZDOOM Discord[/url] for suggesting them![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Also, an addendum:[/b] Unless a huge game-breaking bug gets found, this will most likely be our last patch for the foreseeable future - at least until enough changes are considered and we have an excuse to patch the game again.[/p][p][/p][p]Read a more detailed list below, but beware of potential spoilers for things you may not have found.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Added the ability to auto-fire by holding the shoot button down.[/p][list][*][p]This works both on Mouse/Keyboard and Controller. This should help make shooting less of a chore, especially during longer sessions.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Damocles will now fall sooner in certain locations.[/p][list][*][p]This is to help with speedrunning. We're not saying where these spots are, but there is SOME logic to it. You'll just have to figure that part out yourself![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fourmiworld Version 1.0.4 Velvet Worm released
notes.content: [h3]We've updated Fourmiworld to Version 1.0.4 Velvet Worm.[/h3][p]This is a small patch, fixing a potential soft-lock near the end of the game as well as adding in... something fun.[/p][p][/p][p]Read a more detailed list below, but beware of potential spoilers for things you may not have found.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Fixed an oversight in Altarworld potentially allowing for soft-locks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various Fourmipedia typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Added something fun to the Fourmipedia.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dev commentary mistakenly unlocking for beating the game rather than BoRIS'.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight oversight fixes and tweaks to the banshee.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fourmiworld Version 1.0.3 Ladybug released
notes.content: [h3]We've updated Fourmiworld to Version 1.0.3 Ladybug.[/h3][p]This is a small patch, mainly with a few tweaks to level design.[/p][p][/p][p]As an aside, we would like to briefly thank everyone who has left a review so far! We've now hit the 10 review threshold, and can now show up as positively rated on Steam! We're very happy to see everyone enjoy the game so much, it means a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Read a more detailed list below, but beware of potential spoilers for things you may not have found.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Removed checkpoint icons from the map and adjusted the map's visuals in general to improve visibility and reduce clutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made Damocles prevent you from pausing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unlocking the Sugarslend's Fourmipedia entry without actually encountering it.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the mothrid hive checkpoints closer to the hive in order to prevent players missing them before entering.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly tweaked level design in the Library.[/p][/*][*][p]Another 1 trillion years of dev time to the mantis[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fourmiworld Version 1.0.2 Cricket released
notes.content: [h3]We've updated Fourmiworld to Version 1.0.2 Cricket.[/h3][p]This is a small patch, mainly with a fix to the sound vault code. It should now properly work for everyone as intended.[/p][p][/p][p]Read a more detailed list below, but beware of potential spoilers for things you may not have found.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]The Sound Vault Player will now always play the correct code.[/p][/*][*][p]Fullscreen hotkeys (F11 and F) now work on the title screen/while the game is paused.[/p][/*][*][p]Small other tweaks.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]The game now has an option at launch to choose to play with either Vulkan renderer or OpenGL3. Vulkan is recommended, but if your PC has issues displaying the game, then OpenGL3 should fix it.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fourmiworld Version 1.0.1 Stickbug released
notes.content: [h3]We've updated Fourmiworld to Version 1.0.1 Stickbug.[/h3][p]This is a small patch with some fixes to a few issues we noticed with the map as well as some tweaks and small additions to a certain tenodera.[/p][p][/p][p]Read a more detailed list below, but beware of potential spoilers for things you may not have found.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Psychic Mantis is now able to be about 20% cooler.[/p][/*][*][p]Nish Nosh is now available on the main menu once you've beaten the game, rather than after you obtain the Real Nosh Head achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked entrance cave design slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when obtaining seed upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the Hyperkicks entry within the Fourmipedia.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few end-game issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Scorcozore tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]A few other misc technical changes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: FOURMIWORLD - OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h3]Today's the day, Fourmis![/h3][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3747140/Fourmiworld/"]Fourmiworld is OFFICIALLY released FOR FREE as of RIGHT NOW![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Go hop in and explore Dimension: Planck! Wandereye's just dying for a new expedition![/p][p]If you want the definitive experience of Fourmiworld, or otherwise just want to support us, be sure to check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837130/Fourmiworld_Wandereyes_Writings/"]Wandereye's Writings DLC![/url] On sale NOW with a launch discount![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Can't believe the day's finally here! After months of development, the game is ready to release![/p][p][/p][p]We'll be monitoring the Steam forums and especially our Discord server for any bug reports. We did our best to iron out any we could discover, but there's bound to be at least a few hiding out there. If you find any, send them our way![/p][p][/p][p]Plus, you should just [url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca"]join our Discord server[/url] in general and discuss the game with both us and others. There's a lot of weird, random stuff to discover... what someone else finds might be something you missed entirely.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, it's time for us to get some rest and time for YOU to play![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][list][*][p]Chey[/p][hr][/hr][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3747140/Fourmiworld/" style="button"]Fourmiworld Page[/url] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837130/Fourmiworld_Wandereyes_Writings/" style="button"]Wandereye's Writings Page[/url] [url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca" style="button"]CZDOOM Discord[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fourmiworld: Releasing on August 8th, 2025!
notes.content: [h2]Hey everyfourmi![/h2][p]We're pleased to announce that we've completed the final round of playtesting and are ready to release the game. We have decided that Fourmiworld will release on [b]August 8th, 2025 @ 10:00 AM PST[/b]. Mark your calendars! Additionally, we will have a launch trailer for the occasion that will go live at the same time. (I've gotta start grinding to put it together soon...)[/p][hr][/hr][p]Additionally, we will have an [b]optional paid DLC[/b] to accompany the free base game - [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837130/Fourmiworld_Wandereyes_Writings/"]Wandereye's Writings[/url]. Purchasing this is a way to get the most out of the game and support us should you want to do so.[/p][p][/p][p]To be clear, [b]no gameplay-related features or parts of the map are restricted by the base game[/b]. The DLC enables the ability to see all Fourmipedia entries you've obtained over your adventures. It's great if you're a nerd like I am... You [i]are[/i] a nerd, aren't you?[/p][p][/p][p]We will also be releasing the complete soundtrack for purchase on Steam at a later date. Stay tuned for more info on that later![/p][hr][/hr][p]We really hope that you'll enjoy playing Fourmiworld. It's our first time releasing a game and finishing a project as large as this. If you enjoy it, sharing it with your friends or leaving a review for others to see would be really helpful![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca"]Don't hesitate to also join us on Discord![/url] We'd love to hear your reactions to certain things that stand out to you in the game. It's also a great way to report bugs, should you find any![/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now. Cya![/p][list][*][p]Chey[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837130/Fourmiworld_Wandereyes_Writings/" style="button"]View Fourmiworld: Wandereye's Writings[/url] [url="https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca" style="button"]Join the CZDOOM Discord![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/a2b17406f0f277c97425a391d3b0ee8a1a6df7ac.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thanks for the warm reception to the reveal!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627739/98298b0b925894f6ab1732ebfb619ee32dcdc499.png[/img][/url]

Hi! Thanks for the great reactions to the reveal trailer. We're really glad everyone likes it. We want this game to be the best it can be and think we're making something pretty unique. Fourmiworld isn't just another metroidvania - it may be an easy shorthand for the general progression of it, but this game truly is akin to an ant farm you can form your own personal path through.

We're going to post regular gameplay previews on our social media - [url=https://x.com/cheyennix]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/cheyennix.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/cheyennix]Tumblr[/url].

And of course, you can also join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/XNwpTQEqca]Discord server[/url] for more direct contact with us if you're interested! We don't bite!

Once again, we're so happy to have seen people's positive reactions. We're looking forward to showing more about the game in the future. We hope you'll stick around for those, and the game's release!
Be sure to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

- Cheyenne
